env_allowlist.HOME: ambient elan toolchain root; release evidence remains nonrelease
env_allowlist.PATH: ambient host path; every security-relevant executable used by the checker is selected explicitly and verified by digest
env_allowlist.LANG: ambient for host-side structural checks; Lean replay is forced to C.UTF-8
env_allowlist.LC_ALL: ambient for host-side structural checks; Lean replay is forced to C.UTF-8
env_allowlist.TZ: ambient for host-side structural checks; Lean replay is forced to UTC

network_enforcement: Each Lean subprocess runs under bubblewrap --unshare-net. Host-side JSON, hash, Git, target-manifest, and structural checks perform no network operation.
environment_boundary: This is a worker-side negative-decision recipe, not a release-grade hermetic recipe. It reuses pinned compiled artifacts through the automation-provided read-only canonical .lake link and does not rebuild dependencies.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact six-line release-gate summary bound in release-receipt.json

coverage_semantics: Covered obligations and declarations receive only current provisional narrow-replay corroboration. Reconciled inventory IDs are structurally inspected to derive a fail-closed terminal decision and receive no accepted proof or release credit.
scope_boundary: Self-tests the exact blocked release verdict on the integrated target snapshot. It cannot master-accept validation, inhabit OneVariableEliminationPackage, close the exact root, accept H0/R0 or AUDIT-Z, or supply cold/offline, SBOM, independent-runner, minimal-verifier, deterministic-bundle, or THEOREM-Z evidence.
